# Ferncastle Payments -- Master Service Agreement

Halvard Systems (Customer) and Ferncastle Payments (Vendor) enter into this Master Service Agreement for payment processing and reconciliation services. The document is fictional and was generated for NorthForge testing; it records no real commercial relationship.

## Term and Renewal

The current term of this Master Service Agreement between Halvard Systems and Ferncastle Payments runs until 2027-03-04 and renews automatically for an additional twelve (12) month term on the same terms. Either party may prevent renewal by giving notice twenty (20) days in advance of the renewal date; renewal does not change the agreed fees.

## Termination

Neither Halvard Systems nor Ferncastle Payments may terminate this Master Service Agreement for convenience. Termination requires a material breach that remains uncured ten (10) days after written notice, or the insolvency of the other party.

## Limitation of Liability

The aggregate liability of Halvard Systems and of Ferncastle Payments arising out of this Master Service Agreement is limited to USD 500,000, whether the claim is contractual or otherwise. This cap does not apply to breaches of confidentiality, to data protection breaches, or to unpaid fees, for which liability remains uncapped.

## Governing Law

The laws of the Republic of Ireland govern this Master Service Agreement and any dispute between Halvard Systems and Ferncastle Payments arising out of it. Proceedings shall be brought only in the courts of the Republic of Ireland.

## Data Protection

Personal data processed by Ferncastle Payments on behalf of Halvard Systems is governed by the Data Protection Addendum incorporated into this Master Service Agreement. Ferncastle Payments shall keep Customer Data encrypted in transit and at rest and shall give Halvard Systems forty-five (45) days notice of any new subprocessor.

## Payment Terms

Fees are due thirty (30) days after the invoice date. Halvard Systems may withhold payment of a disputed invoice line while the dispute is open, and Ferncastle Payments may charge one and a half percent (1.5%) per month on undisputed overdue amounts.

## Confidentiality

Confidential Information disclosed under this Master Service Agreement remains the property of the disclosing party. Ferncastle Payments shall return or destroy the Confidential Information of Halvard Systems on request, and confidentiality obligations survive five (5) years beyond termination.

## Notices

Any notice, including notice of non-renewal or termination, must be in writing and sent to contracts@ferncastle.example.com or contracts@halvard.example.com as applicable. Notices sent to any other address are not effective under this Master Service Agreement.

## Signatures

Signed for Halvard Systems by Marit Halvorsen, Director of Procurement. Signed for Ferncastle Payments by Felix Amory, Director of Partnerships. All signatories named in this document are fictional and no real person is represented.
